gold_risks.title: Uncapped and Unlimited Indemnification
gold_risks.why_it_matters: Customer is exposed to unlimited financial liability without consequential damages exclusion.

gold_risks.title: Unilateral Termination for Convenience
key_indicators: Customer shall have no right to terminate
gold_risks.why_it_matters: Only Vendor can terminate at will; early termination by Customer triggers acceleration of all remaining fees.

gold_risks.title: Automatic Renewal Trap
gold_risks.why_it_matters: Strict 180-day certified mail window to avoid an automatic 3-year renewal commitment.

gold_risks.title: Disproportionate Liability Cap Imbalance
gold_risks.why_it_matters: Vendor caps its liability at ₹1,000 while Customer bears uncapped liability.

gold_risks.title: Compounding Daily Late Interest
gold_risks.why_it_matters: Extreme late payment interest compounding daily after only 3 days.

gold_risks.title: Unilateral Modification of Terms and Fees
gold_risks.why_it_matters: Vendor can increase prices and change terms unilaterally.

gold_key_info.penalties: 2.5% per month compounded daily alongside a mandatory ₹50,000 administrative fee
